name: codexmap
description: CodexMap runtime metadata and deployment config for Render.

scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -f server.js ]; then node server.js; elif [ -f orchestrator.js ]; then node orchestrator.js; elif [ -f index.js ]; then node index.js; else echo "No Node entrypoint found (expected server.js, orchestrator.js, or index.js)." >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.start:render: sh -c 'PORT=${PORT:-10000}; export PORT; HOST=${HOST:-0.0.0.0}; export HOST; WS_PORT=${WS_PORT:-$PORT}; export WS_PORT; npm start'
